title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-17
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1982 show with rare Playing > China Cat > Rider and a blissful closing stretch, captured on a mixed soundboard/audience source that suffers wind‑noise and level imbalances but still sounds surprisingly good.
ai_review.review: The performance is notable for its unique setlist – the rare Playing → China Cat Sunflower → Dark Star sequence, a smoking Truckin' jam and an unforgettable final five minutes that many reviewers call pure bliss. Recording-wise the Charlie Miller/Jim Wise mix delivers decent clarity, though wind‑affected mics, amp glitches and a lopsided balance (keys and Bob’s guitar dominate) keep it from being pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical highlights and high energy push the rating up, but recurring technical flaws in the mix lower the overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Wind intermittently hits the microphones, short‑circuit amp noise in set 1, and a noticeable level imbalance (Brent's keys and Bob's guitar louder than Phil's bass). Overall clarity is acceptable but not pristine.

standout_songs: Playing > China Cat Sunflower > Dark Star
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with high energy, though the transition between Althea and Rooster feels abrupt; a rare second‑set sequence adds uniqueness.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals are in fine form; guitar sometimes buried under louder mix.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is noticeably lower in the mix, making it hard to hear his lines.
band_member_comments.Bob: His guitar (referred to as Bobby) sits prominently above Jerry's in the mix and drives the sound.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboards are unusually forward in the mix, adding a bright texture.
